purpose: Run one isolated fresh Agent per case and retain a mechanically verifiable bounded effectiveness review.
instruction: Start without prior conversation. Read only the candidate ADR, Skill, cleanup policy, and the named fixture case. Act as a bounded $evolve weekly effectiveness review. Return only the Agent-owned fields in the result schema. Review every active rule exactly once. Distinguish material use from a context read, treat an irrelevant task as not_applicable, and treat missing opportunity evidence as unknown rather than zero use. A repeated preventable failure after activation schedules semantic review. Low use never authorizes cleanup, and any cleanup remains approval-required. Do not edit the repository. The maintainer harness binds the retained result to canonical-LF SHA-256 digests of every allowed and harness input.
